READMEChangedLines:
- This repository contains [accepted architecture decisions](docs/decisions/README.md), a [PRD with approved product workflows and acceptance criteria](docs/PRD.md), qualification experiments and the first local Rust configuration slice. The [initial request, provenance and evaluation contracts](docs/PRD.md) are documented through AS-M001; its [mission state](.missions/AS-M001/state.json) owns independent acceptance. The shared library provides a bounded four-selector source-capture candidate through `workspace::capture`; AS-M003 whole-mission acceptance remains pending. The executable provides help/version and read-only `config explain` with validated JSONC, advisory defaults, ordered overrides and winning origins. Its TOON-default and explicit JSON views share the Rust resolver/output owners. Analysis, resident sessions, rules, model calls, storage and dataset export are **not implemented**. Unknown commands fail; no command claims that a repository passed analysis.
+ This repository contains [accepted architecture decisions](docs/decisions/README.md), a [PRD with approved product workflows and acceptance criteria](docs/PRD.md), qualification experiments and the first local Rust configuration slice. The [initial request, provenance and evaluation contracts](docs/PRD.md) are documented through AS-M001; its [mission state](.missions/AS-M001/state.json) owns independent acceptance. The shared library provides bounded four-selector source capture through `workspace::capture`; the [AS-M003 mission state](.missions/AS-M003/state.json) owns its packet and whole-mission verdicts. The executable provides help/version and read-only `config explain` with validated JSONC, advisory defaults, ordered overrides and winning origins. Its TOON-default and explicit JSON views share the Rust resolver/output owners. Analysis, resident sessions, rules, model calls, storage and dataset export are **not implemented**. Unknown commands fail; no command claims that a repository passed analysis.
- The [progressive first-release roadmap](docs/IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md) preserves the original L00–L15 plan. AS-M001 is completed with independent acceptance in its [state](.missions/AS-M001/state.json). The AS-M002 configuration slice was recovered from the original implementation and validator chat records after its uncommitted worktree disappeared. The [recovery record](.missions/AS-M002/recovery/README.md) distinguishes historical acceptance, fresh verification and missing mission records. This branch is a review candidate; the original complete state/history and packet evidence have not been recovered. AS-M003 now has a local candidate for all four source comparisons, retained inputs and exact-content rename attribution. Corrected staged capture was accepted; the complete candidate still requires packet examination and fresh independent whole-mission validation.
